channel.title: Crypto Record
channel.description: Crypto Record reports news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation and network upgrades across the crypto market.

item.title: Choosing a Bitcoin-to-Ethereum Route Means Comparing the Whole Trade
item.description: A Bitcoin-to-Ethereum route can use an exchange, a bridge and swap, or native cross-chain liquidity; compare net ETH, fees, trust assumptions and steps.

item.title: What Actually Moves When USDC Crosses Chains
item.description: Moving USDC between chains means coordinating a source transaction, a bridge mechanism and a destination transfer; the token model determines what arrives.

item.title: SEC opens a five-year path for onchain stock trading
item.description: The SEC granted five-year conditional relief for permissioned blockchain venues to trade tokenized US stocks, opening a regulated route with trading limits.

item.title: How to Choose a Monero Bridge for Occasional Use
item.description: A Monero bridge can mean a wrapped token or a swap route; occasional users should choose by custody, destination chain, and whether the route actually supports XMR.

item.title: Meanwhile raises $37.5M in Bain-led Bitcoin insurance round
item.description: Meanwhile raised $37.5 million from existing investors led by Bain Capital Crypto, funding expansion of Bitcoin-denominated life policies for clients outside the US.

item.title: Binance rolls out AI trading interface after 150,000-user beta
item.description: Binance has opened its free AI interface to English-language users after a beta of about 150,000, adding personalized market context and portfolio tools.

item.title: XRP Ledger fixes flaw that could mint 18 trillion tokens
item.description: XRPL patched a payment engine overflow that could create spendable XRP beyond its 100 billion supply; developers say they found no evidence of public exploitation.

item.title: Ether ETFs log nine days of outflows as Solana streak ends
item.description: U.S. spot Ether ETFs lost $542.1 million last week and Solana funds shed $24.8 million, ending 14 weeks of inflows and shifting the fund-flow picture.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates after crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House incumbents for 2026 support, including six $1 million allocations, as Senate gridlock leaves its market-structure bill stalled.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House incumbents after crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake will back 32 House incumbents, with $1 million each for six, after the Senate blocked the CLARITY Act, keeping crypto market rules in play for 2026 races.

item.title: Meanwhile raises $37.5 million in Bain-led round
item.description: Meanwhile raised $37.5 million led by Bain Capital Crypto as its single-premium Bitcoin life policy expands the insurer’s reach to wealthy clients outside the U.S.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House incumbents after crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House incumbents for midterm support and committed $6 million to six, as the Senate’s stalled Clarity Act leaves crypto rules unresolved.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House incumbents after crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake will back 32 House incumbents, including six receiving $1 million each, as the crypto industry looks to the next Congress after the CLARITY Act stalled.

item.title: ESMA tells EU crypto firms to wind down non-compliant stablecoin services
item.description: ESMA says MiCA-authorised crypto firms should stop services tied to non-compliant stablecoins, while supervisors must address legacy holdings within three months.

item.title: Cardano puts issuer controls into token transfer rules
item.description: Cardano's CIP-0113 is live on mainnet, letting regulated token issuers encode transfer checks and, through chosen rules, freeze or seize assets without a hard fork.

item.title: Portal bridge: how wrapped tokens reach your wallet
item.description: Portal bridge moves tokens across chains by locking or burning the source asset, then minting or releasing the matching token after a signed message is redeemed.

item.title: Solana Foundation Unveils Atomic DvP Settlement on Solana
item.description: Solana Foundation released an open-source escrow program to settle tokenized assets and payments together, giving institutions a shared delivery-versus-payment rail on Solana.

item.title: What Does SyncSwap Cost to Swap or Add Liquidity?
item.description: SyncSwap swap costs combine pool fees, price impact and network gas; adding liquidity can add transaction costs and, for imbalanced deposits, a pool fee.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates after CLARITY stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House incumbents who backed the stalled CLARITY Act, committing $1 million each to six as crypto policy shifts toward the midterms.

item.title: OKX-ICE venue plans permissioned trading for tokenized US stocks
item.description: OKXICE outlined a permissioned XLayer venue for tokenized US stocks under a temporary SEC exemption, pairing shares with stablecoins and requiring approved wallets.
